item.title: DC, Maryland rank as some of the best states for women in 2026, study finds
item.description: Despite making up nearly 51% of the U.S. population, women in 2026 still trail men in pay, power and opportunity, according to a new WalletHub state-by-state analysis.In 2026, women across the United States still face notable disparities despite outnumbering men in most states. They make up nearly 51% of the population but comprise more than two-thirds of minimum-wage workers nationwide. According to the Prince George's County Fire Department, a gas leak led to an explosion that brought down power lines. item.title: State Dept. confirms suspect killed by trooper after I-495 stabbings was a foreign service officer
item.description: The man who was shot and killed by a Virginia State trooper after allegedly stabbing four people and a dog on I-495 in Fairfax County on Sunday was a foreign service officer, according to the State Department.The incident was reported around 1:20 p.m. Sunday on the southbound lanes near Exit 52 in Fairfax County. A Virginia State trooper was called to the scene for a report of a road rage incident. When the trooper arrived on scene, he was confronted by a male suspect, who was carrying a knife.

item.title: Customers force attempted armed robbery suspect out of store in Fairfax County
item.description: Fairfax County police are searching for an attempted armed robber who was forced out of a cellphone store by customers. According to police, he tried to restrain the customers but was overpowered by them. Police say just before 8 p.m. on Feb. 23, officers responded to the Cricket Wireless store located at 6330 Springfield Plaza in Springfield for a robbery.
